Name: Item Bags for Mineral Town
Author: sankayoudead
Description:
These item bags were created to suit my own playthrough, but maybe someone will find them useful. :) 

[b]Included are:[/b]

Fishing Bag (for storing fishies - purchasable at Willy's)
Farmer's Bag (for storing tickets, totems, saplings, fruit, vegetables, flowers, forage and scarecrows - purchasable at Pierre's)
Mining Bag (for storing minerals - purchasable at Clint's and Dwarf's)
Cooking Bag (for storing cooking products and consumables - purchasable at Gus's)
(Optional) AIO Bag - (for storing... well, everything in a giant stockpile like a dragon - purchasable at Krobus's)

[b]Installation:[/b]

Simply extract the JSON files from the provided ZIP archive into your ...Mods\ItemBags\assets\Modded Bags folder. 

All credit goes to rexstrife2 and their team, thank you for the permission and for the nostalgia [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13996]your mod[/url] brought up. <3
